architecture_notes: Primary region: eu-west-1 (Ireland) with DR in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt).
VPC topology: customer-managed VPC with private subnets for inference nodes, dedicated NAT instances limited to egress proxy endpoints only.
Inbound: no public ingress to inference instances; control plane connectivity via egress-only encrypted tunnels (mutual TLS) from customer to Redwood control endpoints.
Outbound: strict egress allowed list; S3 endpoints and a limited set of Redwood service IPs; no direct internet access from worker subnets.
KMS: BYOK preferred. Customer uses on-prem HSM (PKCS#11). Need design for Redwood to call customer KMS via VPC endpoint or transit gateway; explore KMS proxy or HSM connector in customer account.
Audit logging: all request/response metadata (no raw PII) to be pushed to customer-owned S3 bucket and forwarded to Splunk; retention 7 years per compliance team.
Networking: VPC peering vs Transit Gateway discussion; they prefer Transit Gateway for multi-account routing. Need exact ASN and CIDR for TGW config.
Artifact storage: model weights to be stored in customer-controlled S3 bucket with enforced SSE-KMS and object lock for model provenance.
Fallbacks: plan for model variant fallback to a locally cached quantized variant if control plane unavailable; need local cache warm-up strategy and cache encryption.
Latency targets: 150ms p95 for chat flows; embedding pipeline target 80ms per vector generation at 1k rps bursts with batching rules (max_batch_size=64, max_wait_ms=10).
